rapport_notes: Friendly and accommodating about the customer being unavailable for a same-day virtual walkthrough, but the call ends without a firm next step.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Rep never asks about biggest concerns; goes straight into address/bedroom-count questions.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concern was raised by the customer to dig into — discussion stayed on logistics (garage contents, distances).
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Not reached — no pricing, differentiators, or SYA content delivered because the virtual walkthrough could not be scheduled on this call (wife may call back).

top_strength: Offered a flexible fallback (send photos/video if a live walkthrough isn't possible) when the customer couldn't do it that day.
coaching_note: This large home (2300+3200 sq ft) never got a scheduled walkthrough appointment or even a square-footage-based estimate — the call ended on 'I'll make some calls' with no confirmed next step, a real gap rather than a clean handoff.
